description: Governed VISUAL-TREATMENT class an element/scene wants — the KIND of visual, not a specific asset. Promoted from the layout engine's Script_Normalizer `suggested_visual_type` axis. This is ADVISORY and upstream: a hint about desired treatment that the realizer reads to help pick a layout, and the asset/render layer reads to pick a concrete asset. It is deliberately distinct from two neighbors it must not duplicate: (1) visual-asset `role` (signature/motif/chrome) in visual-asset.schema.json, which classifies an asset's brand specificity; and (2) `render.asset_ref`, which points at the resolved concrete asset_id. A visual_type says 'this screen wants a diagram'; the visual-assets registry's `content_type_hints` say which assets suit that; render.asset_ref records which asset was actually chosen.

governance.rule: Elements may only use ids defined here. A new value requires a version bump and an entry — the validator rejects anything else.
governance.supplants: The inline `suggested_visual_type` enum in layout-engine intent_sidecar.schema.json (retired in favor of this governed list). Note the id `data_graphic` normalizes the layout engine's 'data graphic' (space) to a valid key.

field: element.expression.visual_type (proposed small addition to element.schema.json, advisory — sits next to the existing advisory expression.layout_hint).
pairs_with: visual-assets.registry.json `content_type_hints` (many-to-many, advisory) and render.asset_ref (the resolved asset).
